caption: The drawing depicts a standing male figure, rendered in full length against a plain, light background. The figure has short dark hair, a beard, and mustache, and features a light to medium complexion. He wears a long, brown robe with the outer garment draped over the left shoulder, which is a darker, almost black color with subtle greenish hues. The robe features red bands on the cuffs and neckline. The man's left hand is visible, holding a fold of the outer garment at chest level, and the right hand is positioned across the body, mostly concealed by the garment. The figure stands on a simple, polygonal pedestal that is brown with lighter edges. The facial features are outlined clearly, and the folds of the garments are defined, giving the figure a three-dimensional appearance. There are no additional objects or backgrounds in the drawing.
title: St. Joseph Carving
